revokeDialog.title: Delete your contribution permanently
revokeDialog.stepUp: Permanent deletion needs a recent sign-in. Sign in again and repeat the action.
revokeDialog.erased: The text of your blocks will be erased and their vectors removed from search. This cannot be undone.
revokeDialog.coAuthored: Articles co-authored with others will lose their canonical status and go back to the Expert Council, noting that part of the content was withdrawn.
revokeDialog.suspendInstead: If you only want to hide your contribution for a while, use “Suspend”.
revokeDialog.failed: The deletion failed. Please try again.

atlas.title: Photos in the atlas
atlas.intro: Suspending hides the photo in the atlas, in recognition and in exports; you can undo it. Permanently revoking deletes the photo, its descriptions and marks. An export someone has already downloaded cannot be undone.

atlas.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
